en: A vintage illustrated postcard featuring two men, one in traditional attire with a feathered hat and a bag labeled '10.000', and another man in a suit wearing dark glasses. The suited man is pointing at a map of Central and Southeastern Europe, where 'JUGOSLAVIJA' (Yugoslavia) is shaded in black, and 'NEMŠKA AVSTRIJA' (German Austria) is shaded in green. The map also labels neighboring countries: ČEHO–SLOVAŠKA (Czechoslovakia), OGRSKA (Hungary), RUMUNIJA (Romania), ITALIJA (Italy), ALBANIJA (Albania), and the JADRANSKO MORJE (Adriatic Sea). The text is in Slovene.
